loss: actual trick CE + 0.2 outcome mean MSE + 0.3 ownership CE + teacher_weight centered PIMC action-value MSE
warmup: one epoch trains action heads only; later epochs jointly train encoder and both heads
selection: minimum validation-family early outcome cross entropy
inputs: visible observation only; NO DDS/PIMC values, proposal masks, true hidden cards, future actions or deal identifiers
targets: actual continuation trick outcomes, true unseen owners, and logged PIMC differences for legal alternatives

resume.reason: Process SIGKILL; resume completed epoch checkpoint with reduced batch
